finding.title: Guard ref.mounted after awaits in PinFlowController._handleSetup/_handleChange/_handleVerify (SM-4)
finding.why: PinFlowController is @Riverpod(keepAlive: true), so it survives normal widget disposal, but keepAlive doesn't prevent explicit container disposal (app teardown, ref.invalidate, hot-restart, or a route pop mid-flight) while a bcrypt verify/hash is in flight — bcrypt is deliberately slow, widening this window. Riverpod 3 throws UnmountedRefException from a post-await `state = ...` write if the container is gone by then. None of the 4 awaited PinService call sites (_handleSetup confirm-save, _handleChange verifyCurrent and confirm-save, _handleVerify) check ref.mounted first, and none of the 628 lines in pin_flow_controller_test.dart dispose the container between firing an async PIN action and that action resolving — every async test either awaits full completion or uses a never-resolving Future, so this path is never exercised. Runtime confirmation needs a test that disposes mid-await and checks the outcome is clean rather than an uncaught exception.
finding.recommendation: Add `if (!ref.mounted) return;` immediately after each of the 4 awaited PinService calls, before the subsequent state write. Add a regression test that disposes the container after the 4th digit triggers the async handler but before the pending PinService future resolves.
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 4 sites has a ref.mounted guard after its await.
A new test disposes mid-flight and passes without an uncaught UnmountedRefException.

finding.title: Replace DateTime.now().toUtc() with a fixed clock in parent_dashboard_aggregator_compute_test.dart's streak test
finding.why: The streak-derivation test seeds 5 consecutive streak_events ending 'today' from the real wall clock instead of a fixed value like the DateTime.utc(2026, 3, 20) literals used elsewhere in the same file. The test's determinism is coupled to the date it happens to run on, which TQ-6 (no wall-clock in tests) exists specifically to rule out.
finding.recommendation: Use a fixed `const todayUtc = DateTime.utc(2026, 3, 20);` instead of DateTime.now().toUtc().
acceptance_criteria: No DateTime.now() call remains in the file; test still passes deterministically.

finding.title: Convert ParentDashboardData/CurriculumSummary/RecentCompletion/EngagementMetrics to @freezed
finding.why: These four domain-result classes are hand-rolled (final fields + const constructor, no ==/hashCode/copyWith) instead of @freezed, as the coding standard requires for domain/state models. No test in this batch currently compares whole-object equality, so this hasn't produced a false pass yet, but the first test that writes `expect(data.curricula.first, CurriculumSummary(...))` expecting structural equality will silently compare object identity instead.
finding.recommendation: Annotate the four classes with @freezed, or record a documented judgment-call exception if they're deliberately excluded.
acceptance_criteria: The four classes are @freezed, or a coding-standards.md judgment-call entry documents why not.

finding.title: Delete four dead domain-layer files in features/profiles/domain (pin_flow_machine.dart, profile_creation_use_case.dart, set_parent_pin_use_case.dart, verify_parent_pin_use_case.dart)
finding.rule: AG-6 dead code / Fowler dead code
finding.why: Repo-wide grep for the class names (PinFlowMachine, ProfileCreationUseCase, SetParentPinUseCase, VerifyParentPinUseCase) finds zero constructors/imports anywhere in lib/ outside each class's own file. ProfileCreationUseCase has a dedicated passing unit test (profile_creation_use_case_test.dart) that exercises code no production path ever runs; SetParentPinUseCase/VerifyParentPinUseCase have neither callers nor tests. pin_flow_machine.dart's own header claims PinFlowController 'wraps this machine' — false; PinFlowController reimplements the same state machine independently (see next finding). Combined this is 647 lines of orphaned domain logic (atomic profile+curriculum creation, PIN set/verify as sealed results) that misleads a reader into thinking PIN/profile-creation business rules live here, when the real logic is duplicated directly in the presentation layer.
finding.recommendation: Delete all four files and their now-orphaned tests, or if the atomic profile+curriculum-seed behavior in ProfileCreationUseCase is actually wanted, wire it into a @riverpod provider and call it from showAddProfileDialog instead of ProfileRepositoryImpl.createProfile.
acceptance_criteria: grep for PinFlowMachine/ProfileCreationUseCase/SetParentPinUseCase/VerifyParentPinUseCase across lib/ returns zero hits outside deleted files (or, if kept, returns a real caller)
flutter analyze and dart run build_runner build stay clean after removal
orphaned test files for the deleted classes are removed in the same change

finding.title: Consolidate the PIN entry/verify/change/setup state machine duplicated across 3 live implementations in features/profiles
finding.rule: SM-1/Fowler duplication, AG-4 duplicate top-level names
finding.why: The 4-digit-entry + busy-lock + lockout state machine is hand-rolled independently in PinFlowController (setup mode), _ParentPinSetupDialog (parent_pin_setup_dialog.dart), and _ParentPinVerificationDialog/_ParentPinChangeDialog (parent_pin_keypad_dialog.dart) — four near-identical but textually distinct copies of the same transitions (mismatch → reset to enterNew, lockout → freeze keypad, 4th digit → async verify/save). Worse, PinFlowController ALSO fully implements change/verify modes (and pin_flow_machine.dart even duplicates the enum names PinFlowMode/PinFlowStep as public top-level symbols, AG-4), but grepping every `.push(` call site in lib/ shows PinFlowVerifyRoute and PinFlowChangeRoute are registered in app_router.dart and never pushed anywhere — the app's real verify/change UX goes through the dialog-based _ParentPin*Dialog classes via router_provider.dart's promptForPin and settings_screen.dart. A confirmed device bug (PP-1: rapid 5th-digit tap racing the confirm-step reset) was fixed in _ParentPinSetupDialog's specific busy-before-reset ordering; because the other three copies re-derive the same logic independently, a fix like this has no guarantee of applying to the others.
finding.recommendation: Extract one shared PIN-entry state-machine class/notifier (digits, busy, lockedOut, lockoutMinutes, transitions) and have setup/verify/change dialogs and PinFlowScreen all delegate to it; delete PinFlowController's unreachable change/verify branches and their dead routes, or wire a real navigation call site to them.
acceptance_criteria: Only one implementation owns the digit-buffer/busy/lockout transition logic; setup, verify, and change UIs all call into it
Either PinFlowVerifyRoute/PinFlowChangeRoute get a real .push call site, or they and PinFlowController's change/verify modes are deleted
pin_flow_controller_test.dart and parent_pin_keypad_dialog_test.dart continue to pass against the consolidated implementation
